scope: scripts/qualify_plcsim_gaps.py --hardware-download on Debug builds of 4f4f7338 (artifacts/hw1, git archive) with one owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU1511 instance on Softbus of a scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 and one owned TIA Portal V21 Update 3. simulation_download_online refused hardware: true without allowStop and with softwareScope changes (InvalidRequest). After hardware_cpu_memory_bytes enabled the system and clock memory bytes, a sim_observe watch started, and simulation_download_online with hardware: true (DownloadOptions.Hardware | Software, keepActualValues, allowStop) answered StopModules StopAll, ConsistentBlocksDownload, UserManagementDownload KeepOnlineUserManagementData, AlarmTextLibrariesDownload and StartModules StartModule; TIA reported Success with 0 errors, the hardware configuration loaded and the CPU in RUN before and after. The watch collected one hardwareConfiguration event (errorCode OK) beside an ipAddress, two softwareConfiguration and operating-state/LED events. Non-retained DB values restarted from their start values (Ob82 7 -> 0), as after any stop.
limitations: One owned Softbus CPU 1511 instance; the hardware change is the CPU's system and clock memory bytes. Module changes, other CPUs and TCP/IP instances are not exercised.
keepActualValues keeps no non-retained value across a hardware download: the CPU stops and restarts.
Only the hardware-download mode ran; the rest of the PLCSIM gaps corpus was not rerun on this build.
